"[delegate worktree]
Run all file edits, tests, and git commands inside this worktree: /home/ops/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/deepseek/impl-9062
Do not switch branches in the main checkout.
If you need a fresh base, run `git fetch origin main` INSIDE this worktree — `origin` here points at the canonical GitHub remote and fetch works from any linked worktree. NEVER use the primary checkout as a source of freshness (no `git -C <primary> pull/fetch/checkout`); it is the human's interactive home.

[shared project interpreter]
Never create, copy, symlink, activate, or use a `.venv` inside this worktree. Run every project Python command with `/home/ops/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/python` (the absolute primary interpreter), never `python`, `.venv/bin/python`, or `python -m venv .venv`. Do not change `PYTHONPATH` merely because the worker cwd is a worktree.
Sparse-checkout is active: these trees are NOT present: curriculum, data/projects, registry/projects, wiki. To materialize one inside this worktree, run `git sparse-checkout add curriculum` `git sparse-checkout add data/projects` `git sparse-checkout add registry/projects` `git sparse-checkout add wiki` (for example `git sparse-checkout add data/projects`). Do not invent content for missing paths.

[test scope]
Run only the tests that cover the files you changed, including tests of code that imports a changed shared helper, and name those test files explicitly.
Never collect the whole `tests/` tree (`pytest tests`, `pytest tests -k …`); never `-n auto` or `-n` above 2.
Run tests in the foreground and wait for them (never end the turn while a test runs in the background).
The full suite runs in the PR's CI (and again in the merge queue on the merged tree) — that is the proof; do not trigger extra full runs. Use `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <branch>` only when the brief explicitly asks for it (a branch with no PR yet, a baseline capture, or diagnosis).

[write-mode closeout]
Commit your work (use the literal trailer in `$LU_X_AGENT_TRAILER`).
`git push -u origin HEAD`
Leave `git status --porcelain` empty (commit or delete scratch files).
Do not open or merge PRs unless the brief says so; report the pushed head SHA and clean status.

[optional delivery signal]
If you finish with zero commits (a verified no-op), you MAY end your final response with one machine-readable line as positive proof: `DELIVERABLE: {\"outcome\":\"no_change\",\"reason\":\"why no changes are required\"}`. This line is optional — its absence never fails the dispatch.

# impl-9062: one composite Python-env action for ci.yml, pinned postgres digest, cheaper checkouts (issue #9062)

Commit trailer: `$LU_X_AGENT_TRAILER` verbatim. Work in this dispatch worktree on the dispatch branch; `git push origin HEAD` is requested and authorized (never `main`, no force). No PR, no merge. Foreground only. Primary interpreter `/home/ops/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/python`. Do not use `git stash`. Do not start other dispatches.

Evidence preamble (#M-4): every claim names the command and quotes raw output.

1. Read issue #9062 (`gh issue view 9062`). The audit line numbers are stale: #9079 (#9061) changed the install blocks today. Work from current `.github/workflows/ci.yml` on your base.
2. Extract the repeated \"Set up uv → Install Python deps (offline-first uv install with index retry) → install ./packages/v4-runtime → Hydrate Atlas lexicon manifest\" sequence into one composite action under `.github/actions/` (inputs only where the three copies genuinely differ). Behaviour must be identical, including the #9061 retry/offline fallback and every `if:` condition. Every `uses:` must stay pinned to a full 40-hex commit SHA (the repo will enforce SHA pinning).
3. Replace `postgres:16` with `postgres:16@sha256:<digest>`; get the digest with `docker buildx imagetools inspect postgres:16` or the registry API and quote the command output.
4. `fetch-depth: 0`: for each job that uses it, determine whether it reads git history (e.g. diff against base, merge-base, `git log`). Where it does not, use a shallow or `filter: blob:none` checkout; where it does, leave it and say why. List each job with its decision and evidence.
5. Validate: `actionlint` and `zizmor --persona=pedantic .github/` (install via pip into a temp venv if absent; quote output), and `tests/test_ci_pr_triggers.py` + `tests/test_ci_shard_partition.py` (only these). Collected test count must be unchanged — the tier selection is not touched.
6. Measurement: push, then `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <your branch>` once (authorized for this measurement), wait for it with `gh run watch`, and report per-shard setup time (job start → first \"Run pytest\" step start) from `gh run view <id> --json jobs`, compared with one recent main/merge_group run.
7. Commit `perf(ci): one composite Python-env action, pinned postgres digest, shallow checkouts where history is unused (#9062)`, push, report head SHA.
"

Pytest shard setup drops from ~2.1 to ≤ 1.5 min, and the copied install/hydrate blocks become one composite action so they cannot drift.

## Why / evidence
Audit §A: p95 PR wall 11.2 min, straggler max/mean shard 1.7, setup 2.1 min per shard, 5 % of merge_group runs ejected by flakes, 71/103 PR runs label-forced to full. Specific rows: see scope.

ci.yml (audit B10: install block ×3 at :197-207, :368-380, :570-578 and Hydrate ×3; B2: `postgres:16` → digest at :320; B9: `fetch-depth: 0` → `filter: blob:none` or shallow where history is not read, measured); a composite action under `.github/actions/`.

## Non-goals
Anything owned by another #8875 child; changing the required check (CI Gate).

The files and audit rows named in scope.

10 runs: setup ≤ 1.5 min per shard; actionlint and zizmor clean; collected test count unchanged.

merge

#8967 merged; N4 (same file, serialize)

162:     # job outputs below, never its `conclusion`: under continue-on-error a

168:     # dependency install.
169:     timeout-minutes: 35
170:     outputs:

172:       ruff: ${{ steps.ruff.outcome }}
173:       plan_validate: ${{ steps.plan_validate.outcome }}
174:       typesafe: ${{ steps.typesafe.outcome }}
175:     steps:
176:       - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
177:         with:
178:           persist-credentials: false
179:           # Full history: plan-validate --strict compares _grammar.yaml
180:           # against git merge-base HEAD origin/main; TypeSafe triage diffs
181:           # BASE_SHA..HEAD_SHA.
182:           fetch-depth: 0
183:       - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
184:         with:
185:           python-version-file: '.python-version'
186:           cache: pip

201:       - name: Install preflight Python deps

213:           .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation ./packages/v4-runtime

216:       - name: Hydrate Atlas lexicon manifest
217:         if: needs.changes.outputs.preflight == 'true'
218:         run: |
219:           .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from lexicon.manifest_io import load_manifest; load_manifest(); print('Atlas manifest verified against pointer')"
220:       - name: Preflight
221:         id: preflight
222:         if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.preflight == 'true' }}
223:         timeout-minutes: 8
224:         env:
225:           LU_PYTEST_TMP_BUDGET_GB: "5"
226:           # Registered non-repo_wide invariants that also run here, one path per
227:           # line (#8750). tests/test_ci_preflight.py checks every path exists.
228:           PREFLIGHT_EXTRA_TESTS: |
229:             tests/curriculum/arc/test_decisions_record.py
230:         run: |
231:           set -euo pipefail
232:           # Same allowlist construction and flags as the shards' repo_wide leg.
233:           repo_wide_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-repo-wide-files.txt"
234:           git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.repo_wide' \
235:             | sort > "$repo_wide_list" || true
236:           [ -s "$repo_wide_list" ] || { echo "no repo_wide tests found; the repo_wide marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
237:           extra_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-preflight-extra-files.txt"
238:           printf '%s\n' "$PREFLIGHT_EXTRA_TESTS" | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' > "$extra_list"
239:           [ -s "$extra_list" ] || { echo "PREFLIGHT_EXTRA_TESTS is empty" >&2; exit 1; }
240:           # Run both sets even when the first fails, so one run reports every
241:           # broken invariant; the step still fails if either did.
242:           status=0
243:           LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$repo_wide_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
244:             -m 'repo_wide and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
245:             -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
246:             --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v || status=$?
247:           LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$extra_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
248:             -m 'not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
249:             -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
250:             --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v || status=$?
251:           exit "$status"
252:       - name: Ruff
253:         id: ruff
254:         if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false' }}
255:         timeout-minutes: 5
256:         # `ruff check` lints (unused imports, style rules); it does not check
257:         # formatting — `ruff format --check` is a separate subcommand this
258:         # step never runs, and neither does .pre-commit-config.yaml. A file
259:         # can pass this step and still drift from `ruff format` (#8795 found
260:         # tests/conftest.py this way). Not added here: `ruff format --check`
261:         # currently flags ~2050 files repo-wide, so adopting it needs its own
262:         # reformat pass, not a silent gate flip on this line.

264:           set -euo pipefail
265:           python -m pip install "$(grep -E '^ruff==' requirements-lock.txt)"

268:         id: plan_validate
269:         # No tier condition: this check always runs. The validator is
270:         # path-scoped like content-ci.yml's section7-xref (git diff inside the
271:         # step): on pull_request it skips unless its inputs changed; other
272:         # events (merge_group, schedule, dispatch) always run it. The arc
273:         # landing check after it always runs.
274:         if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
275:         timeout-minutes: 10
276:         env:
277:           EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
278:         run: |
279:           set -euo pipefail
280:           python -m pip install PyYAML jsonschema
281:           git fetch --no-tags --prune origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
282:           validate_plans=true
283:           if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
284:             changed=$(git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- \
285:               curriculum/l2-uk-en/lesson-plans \
286:               curriculum/l2-uk-en/evidence \
287:               schemas/module-plan-v2.schema.json \
288:               scripts/curriculum/validate)
289:             if [ -z "$changed" ]; then
290:               echo "No v2 plan inputs changed; skipping the v2 plan validator."
291:               validate_plans=false

410:       - name: Plan pytest shard files

436:       - name: Start memory sampler

444:           # Sample controller + execnet worker RSS and whole-VM memory every
445:           # 15s. RSS sums shared pages more than once; `free` also shows the
446:           # runner capacity. Neither is a before/after-only peak estimate.
447:           (
448:             echo "sampling_interval_seconds=15"

450:               echo "cgroup_memory_max_bytes=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max)"

455:               { ps -C python -C python3 -o rss=,args= || true; } | awk '
456:                 /-m pytest|import sys;exec[(]eval/ { rss += $1; processes++ }
457:                 END { printf "pytest_rss_mib=%.1f pytest_processes=%d\n", rss / 1024, processes }

477:             # narrow allowlist the selected tier uses, so collection stays cheap.
478:             repo_wide_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-repo-wide-files.txt"
479:             git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.repo_wide' \
480:               | sort > "$repo_wide_list" || true
481:             [ -s "$repo_wide_list" ] || { echo "no repo_wide tests found; the repo_wide marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
482:             LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$repo_wide_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
483:               -m 'repo_wide and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
484:               -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
485:               --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
486:             # A curriculum/ or wiki/ docs PR runs no reads_content tests
487:             # otherwise, so an edit that breaks a test reading those live trees
488:             # merges green and turns main red on the next full-tier run (#8720).
489:             # Find the marked modules with the same narrow allowlist pattern as
490:             # the repo_wide leg; an empty list fails the step loudly.
491:             if [ "$DOCS_READS_CONTENT" = "true" ]; then
492:               reads_content_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-reads-content-files.txt"

494:                 | sort > "$reads_content_list" || true
495:               [ -s "$reads_content_list" ] || { echo "no reads_content tests found; the reads_content marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
496:               LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$reads_content_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
497:                 -m 'reads_content and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
498:                 -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
499:                 --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
500:             fi
501:             exit 0
502:           fi
503:           if [ "$PYTEST_MODE" = "content" ]; then
504:             # Content class (#8399): only tests that read curriculum/site/wiki

507:             # safety net run explicitly so it cannot marker-drift away.
508:             # Marker filter and timeout mirror the full PR tier below (D5).
509:             mkdir -p ci-artifacts
510:             .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
511:               -m 'reads_content and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
512:               -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
513:               --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v --durations=25 \
514:               --junitxml="ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-${SHARD}.xml"
515:             .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_ci_shard_partition.py -m 'not slow' --timeout=120 \
516:               --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
517:             exit 0
518:           fi
519:           mkdir -p ci-artifacts
520:           # Single initial path + tests/conftest.py's pytest_ignore_collect allowlist
521:           # hook (LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES, exported above) replaces positional file
522:           # arguments — cheap collection, not a change in which tests run.
523:           .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
524:             --timeout-method=thread -m 'not atlas_release and not slow' --strict-markers \
525:             --override-ini addopts=-v --durations=25 \
526:             --junitxml="ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-${SHARD}.xml"
527:           if [ "$PYTEST_MODE" = "selected" ]; then
528:             # Repo-wide tree-scanning tests (#8707) have no import link to the
529:             # changed module, so import selection can never pick them. Run them
530:             # under their own allowlist so collection stays narrow, whatever
531:             # candidates the Changes job chose.
532:             repo_wide_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-repo-wide-files.txt"
533:             git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.repo_wide' \
534:               | sort > "$repo_wide_list" || true
535:             [ -s "$repo_wide_list" ] || { echo "no repo_wide tests found; the repo_wide marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
536:             LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$repo_wide_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
537:               -m 'repo_wide and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
538:               -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
539:               --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v \
540:               --junitxml="ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-${SHARD}-repo-wide.xml"
541:           fi

595:           if ! uv pip install --offline --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"; then
596:             echo 'uv cache incomplete; retrying installation from the index'
597:             uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"

599:           .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation ./packages/v4-runtime

602:       - name: Hydrate Atlas lexicon manifest

604:           .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from lexicon.manifest_io import load_manifest; load_manifest(); print('Atlas manifest verified against pointer')"
605:       - name: Verify needs_artifact skip set
606:         run: |
607:           set -euo pipefail
608:           mkdir -p ci-artifacts
609:           git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)test_[^/]+\.py$' > ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-files.txt
610:           export LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES=ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-files.txt
611:           .venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -m needs_artifact -q --strict-markers \

613:           if [ "${collection_status:-0}" -ne 0 ] && [ "$collection_status" -ne 5 ]; then

628:           import sys
629:           import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
630:           from pathlib import Path
631:           from scripts.storage.test_baseline import nodeid_to_junit_id
632: 
633:           expected_path = Path("registry/artifacts/needs-artifact-expected.txt")
634:           expected = {
635:               line.strip()
636:               for line in expected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
637:               if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
638:           }
639:           collected = set()
640:           for line in Path("ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-collected.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
641:               if ".py::" not in line:
642:                   continue
643:               collected.add(nodeid_to_junit_id(line))
644:           if collected != expected:
645:               print(f"needs_artifact collection differs: missing={sorted(expected - collected)} unexpected={sorted(collected - expected)}")
646:               sys.exit(1)
647:           report = ET.parse("ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-audit.xml")
648:           artifact_skips = set()
649:           for case in report.iter("testcase"):
650:               case_id = f"{case.get('classname', '')}::{case.get('name', '')}"
651:               skipped = case.find("skipped")
652:               reason = "" if skipped is None else skipped.get("message", "") + (skipped.text or "")
653:               if "needs_artifact:" in reason:
654:                   artifact_skips.add(case_id)
655:           missing = sorted(expected - artifact_skips)
656:           unexpected = sorted(artifact_skips - expected)
657:           if missing or unexpected:
658:               print("needs_artifact skip set does not match registry/artifacts/needs-artifact-expected.txt")
659:               if missing:
660:                   print("expected IDs not skipped:\n  " + "\n  ".join(missing))
661:               if unexpected:
662:                   print("unexpected artifact skips:\n  " + "\n  ".join(unexpected))
663:               sys.exit(1)
664:           print(f"needs_artifact collected={len(collected)} skips={len(artifact_skips)} expected={len(expected)}")
665:           PY

735:           python - <<'PY'
736:           from pathlib import Path
737:           import os
738:           import subprocess
739: 
740:           from scripts.orchestration import curriculum_readiness as readiness
741:           from scripts.orchestration.preparation_evidence import load_manual_evidence
742: 
743:           root = Path.cwd()
744:           base_sha = os.environ.get("BASE_SHA", "")
745:           head_sha = os.environ.get("HEAD_SHA", "HEAD") or "HEAD"

752:               subprocess.check_output(
753:                   [
754:                       "git",
755:                       "diff",
756:                       "--no-renames",
757:                       "--name-only",
758:                       "--diff-filter=AM",
759:                       base_sha,

764:           )
765:           deleted = set(
766:               subprocess.check_output(
767:                   [
768:                       "git",

770:                       "--no-renames",

772:                       "--diff-filter=D",

780:           _, manifest_slugs = readiness.load_manifest_track(root, "bio")

782: 
783:           def is_bio_preparation_path(raw_path: str) -> bool:
784:               path = Path(raw_path)
785:               parts = path.parts
786:               wiki_slug = (
787:                   path.name.removesuffix(".sources.yaml")
788:                   if raw_path.endswith(".sources.yaml")

790:               )
791:               return (
792:                   parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "plans", "bio")
793:                   or parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "bio", "discovery")
794:                   or raw_path == "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml"
795:                   or parts[:3] == ("docs", "research", "bio")
796:                   or (parts[:2] == ("wiki", "figures") and wiki_slug in manifest_set)
797:               )
798: 
799:           deleted_preparation = sorted(path for path in deleted if is_bio_preparation_path(path))
800:           if deleted_preparation:
801:               raise SystemExit(f"BIO preparation files may not be deleted: {deleted_preparation}")
802: 
803:           registry_path = root / "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml"
804:           evidence = load_manual_evidence(registry_path, manifest_set)
805:           active_holds = {
806:               slug
807:               for slug, gates in evidence.items()

811:           changed_slugs = set()
812:           for raw_path in changed:
813:               path = Path(raw_path)
814:               parts = path.parts
815:               slug = None
816:               if parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "plans", "bio"):
817:                   slug = path.stem
818:               elif parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "bio", "discovery"):
819:                   slug = path.stem
820:               elif parts[:3] == ("docs", "research", "bio"):

823:                       base_text = subprocess.check_output(
824:                           ["git", "show", f"{base_sha}:{raw_path}"],
825:                           text=True,
826:                           stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
827:                       )

830:                   try:
831:                       head_text = (root / raw_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

836:               elif parts[:2] == ("wiki", "figures"):

838:               if slug in manifest_set:
839:                   changed_slugs.add(slug)
840: 
841:           if "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml" in changed:
842:               from scripts.orchestration.preparation_evidence import UniqueKeyLoader
843:               import yaml
844: 
845:               registry_rel = "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml"
846:               try:
847:                   base_registry_text = subprocess.check_output(
848:                       ["git", "show", f"{base_sha}:{registry_rel}"],
849:                       text=True,
850:                       stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
851:                   )
852:               except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
853:                   base_registry_text = "version: 1\nentries: {}\n"
854:               base_registry = yaml.load(base_registry_text, Loader=UniqueKeyLoader)
855:               head_registry = yaml.load(registry_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), Loader=UniqueKeyLoader)
856:               base_entries = base_registry.get("entries", {})
857:               head_entries = head_registry.get("entries", {})
858:               registry_changed_slugs = {
859:                   slug
860:                   for slug in set(base_entries) | set(head_entries)
861:                   if base_entries.get(slug) != head_entries.get(slug)
862:               }
863:               off_manifest_changes = registry_changed_slugs - manifest_set
864:               if off_manifest_changes:
865:                   raise SystemExit(
866:                       f"promotion evidence changed off-manifest slugs: {sorted(off_manifest_changes)}"
867:                   )
868:               changed_slugs.update(registry_changed_slugs)
869: 
870:           targets = active_holds | changed_slugs
871:           for slug in sorted(targets, key=manifest_slugs.index):
872:               result = readiness.evaluate_preparation("bio", slug, repo_root=root)
873:               finding_ids = {finding["id"] for finding in result["findings"]}
874:               if slug in active_holds:
875:                   if result["next_action"] != "stop" or "PREPARATION_HOLD_ACTIVE" not in finding_ids:
876:                       raise SystemExit(f"active hold does not fail closed for {slug}")

878:               failed = [item["id"] for item in result["requirements"] if not item["passed"]]
879:               if failed:
880:                   raise SystemExit(f"changed BIO capsule is not preparation-ready: {slug}: {failed}")
881: 
882:           print(
883:               f"BIO preparation PASS: entries={len(evidence)} "
884:               f"changed_slugs={len(changed_slugs)} active_holds={len(active_holds)}"

944:           FRONTEND: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.frontend }}

952:           FC_RUFF: ${{ needs.fast-checks.outputs.ruff }}

  # behind it. S1: ci-gate is `if: always()`, so it still runs after that

  # GitHub reports a conditionally skipped job as success for branch protection

  # ref-keyed group and never cancel.

display.text:
name: CI

# New CI (Fable 5.1 spec 2026-09-03). Same jobs on pull_request and merge_group.
# Required GitHub context is still named "CI Gate".

concurrency:
  # pull_request runs key by PR number, not head SHA (#8505): a new push
  # cancels the stale in-flight run for the previous SHA instead of queuing
  # behind it. S1: ci-gate is `if: always()`, so it still runs after that
  # cancel and fails unless every required dependency for the classified tier
  # succeeded in this same run. A skipped required check is not a substitute —
  # GitHub reports a conditionally skipped job as success for branch protection
  # (docs.github.com troubleshooting-required-status-checks
  # #handling-skipped-but-required-checks). merge_group and schedule keep the
  # ref-keyed group and never cancel.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.run_id || github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  UV_HTTP_RETRIES: '6'
  UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT: '60'
  PIP_RETRIES: '6'
  PIP_TIMEOUT: '60'
  # Full-tier default; workflow_dispatch may override it for shard measurements.
  # Selected/docs modes emit shard_count=1 from Changes; plan-files reads
  # needs.changes.outputs.shard_count (not this env alone) so selected never
  # LPT-partitions into unused buckets.
  PYTEST_SHARD_COUNT: ${{ inputs.shards || '10' }}

on:
  # No `edited` or `labeled` (#8505): neither a PR-body edit nor a label may
  # restart CI on an unchanged commit. The negated-closing-reference body guard
  # lives in pr-body-guard.yml, which runs on `edited`. A `full-ci` label is
  # read from the API by Changes: it forces the full tier on the next push and
  # always in the merge-queue run, which gates every change into main.
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      shards:
        description: Full-tier pytest shards for measured CI runs
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: ['4', '6', '8', '10']
  # Full PR-tier floor; slow tests remain in pytest-slow-nightly.yml.
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 3 * * *'

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      # classify_changes.py reads current PR labels via the API for
      # pull_request and for every PR in a merge group (#8505); a lookup
      # error fails closed to the full tier.
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      docs_only: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.docs_only }}
      docs_reads_content: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.docs_reads_content }}
      frontend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.frontend }}
      backend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.backend }}
      shards: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.shards }}
      pytest_mode: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.pytest_mode }}
      shard_count: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.shard_count }}
      pytest_candidates: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.pytest_candidates }}
      # The one "should preflight run" decision (#8750): classify_changes
      # .preflight_for. The fast-checks preflight step and CI Gate both read it.
      preflight: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.preflight }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Sparse working tree; classify uses `git ls-tree HEAD` for existence /
          # stem-collision / safety-net checks (object tree, not working tree).
          sparse-checkout: |
            scripts/ci/
            scripts/__init__.py
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Test classifier
        run: python3 -m unittest scripts.ci.test_classify_changes
      - id: classify
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.merge_group.head_ref }}
          HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
        run: python3 -m scripts.ci.classify_changes
      - name: Freeze pytest duration source
        if: steps.classify.outputs.pytest_mode == 'full'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/pytest_shards.py ci-durations \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --output ci-artifacts/pytest-file-durations.json
      - name: Share pytest duration source
        if: steps.classify.outputs.pytest_mode == 'full'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: pytest-duration-source
          path: ci-artifacts/pytest-file-durations.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  secret-scan:
    name: Secret scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Resolve secret scan commit scope
        id: secret-scan-scope
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          MERGE_GROUP_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha || '' }}
          MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.merge_group.head_sha || '' }}
          PUSH_BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before || '' }}
          PUSH_AFTER_SHA: ${{ github.event.after || '' }}
        run: python3 scripts/ci/secret_scan_scope.py
      - name: Gate scrubbed public identifiers
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          OPSEC_RANGE: ${{ steps.secret-scan-scope.outputs.opsec_range }}
        run: |
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            python3 scripts/audit/lint_opsec_leaks.py "${PR_BASE_SHA}...${PR_HEAD_SHA}" --public-identifiers
          elif [ -n "$OPSEC_RANGE" ]; then
            python3 scripts/audit/lint_opsec_leaks.py --commit-range "$OPSEC_RANGE" --public-identifiers
          else
            python3 scripts/audit/lint_opsec_leaks.py --public-identifiers
          fi
      - run: python3 scripts/audit/check_no_internal_ids.py --changed-vs-base origin/main
      # The negated-closing-reference PR-body guard moved to
      # pr-body-guard.yml (#8505): it must rerun on `edited`, which this
      # workflow does not subscribe to.
      - uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@f714bf454f350590f4a24c3ddb1aef02c35bf5b6 # v3.97.5
        with:
          base: ${{ steps.secret-scan-scope.outputs.trufflehog_base }}
          head: ${{ steps.secret-scan-scope.outputs.trufflehog_head }}
          extra_args: --results=verified,unknown --exclude-paths=.trufflehogignore --exclude-detectors=Lob

  fast-checks:
    # Short checks share one runner (#8750 phase A.2): each held a full slot
    # under the account's concurrent-job cap while the pytest shards waited.
    # Every check is its own step with its own id and timeout. `!cancelled()`
    # keeps a failed check from skipping the ones after it, so one run
    # reports every red check. CI Gate reads each step's `outcome` from the
    # job outputs below, never its `conclusion`: under continue-on-error a
    # failed step concludes `success`. A re-run repeats all four checks.
    name: Fast checks
    needs: [changes]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Step budgets 8 + 5 + 10 + 5 = 28, plus 7 for checkout and the preflight
    # dependency install.
    timeout-minutes: 35
    outputs:
      preflight: ${{ steps.preflight.outcome }}
      ruff: ${{ steps.ruff.outcome }}
      plan_validate: ${{ steps.plan_validate.outcome }}
      typesafe: ${{ steps.typesafe.outcome }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Full history: plan-validate --strict compares _grammar.yaml
          # against git merge-base HEAD origin/main; TypeSafe triage diffs
          # BASE_SHA..HEAD_SHA.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version-file: '.python-version'
          cache: pip
      # Preflight setup. Early PR signal for repo-wide invariants (#8750). The
      # full and selected shards still run the same repo_wide set (the
      # backstop) and do not wait for this job, so a green run is no slower; a
      # red invariant just reports minutes before the shards finish. No
      # Postgres, npm or native apt deps: no repo_wide test uses them (see
      # docs/runbooks/ci-gate.md). The venv lives in .venv; ruff,
      # plan-validate and TypeSafe triage use the setup-python interpreter.
      - name: Set up uv
        if: needs.changes.outputs.preflight == 'true'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
        with:
          version: '0.12.9'
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: requirements-lock.txt
      - name: Install preflight Python deps
        if: needs.changes.outputs.preflight == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m venv .venv
          # Same install as the pytest shards.
          grep -viE '^(torch|torchvision|open_clip_torch|stanza)==' requirements-lock.txt \
            > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"
          if ! uv pip install --offline --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"; then
            echo 'uv cache incomplete; retrying installation from the index'
            uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"
          fi
          .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation ./packages/v4-runtime
          .venv/bin/python scripts/audit/check_ci_dependencies.py
          .venv/bin/python packages/v4-runtime/build_assets.py
      - name: Hydrate Atlas lexicon manifest
        if: needs.changes.outputs.preflight == 'true'
        run: |
          .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from lexicon.manifest_io import load_manifest; load_manifest(); print('Atlas manifest verified against pointer')"
      - name: Preflight
        id: preflight
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.preflight == 'true' }}
        timeout-minutes: 8
        env:
          LU_PYTEST_TMP_BUDGET_GB: "5"
          # Registered non-repo_wide invariants that also run here, one path per
          # line (#8750). tests/test_ci_preflight.py checks every path exists.
          PREFLIGHT_EXTRA_TESTS: |
            tests/curriculum/arc/test_decisions_record.py
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Same allowlist construction and flags as the shards' repo_wide leg.
          repo_wide_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-repo-wide-files.txt"
          git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.repo_wide' \
            | sort > "$repo_wide_list" || true
          [ -s "$repo_wide_list" ] || { echo "no repo_wide tests found; the repo_wide marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
          extra_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-preflight-extra-files.txt"
          printf '%s\n' "$PREFLIGHT_EXTRA_TESTS" | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' > "$extra_list"
          [ -s "$extra_list" ] || { echo "PREFLIGHT_EXTRA_TESTS is empty" >&2; exit 1; }
          # Run both sets even when the first fails, so one run reports every
          # broken invariant; the step still fails if either did.
          status=0
          LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$repo_wide_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
            -m 'repo_wide and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
            -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
            --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v || status=$?
          LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$extra_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
            -m 'not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
            -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
            --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v || status=$?
          exit "$status"
      - name: Ruff
        id: ruff
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false' }}
        timeout-minutes: 5
        # `ruff check` lints (unused imports, style rules); it does not check
        # formatting — `ruff format --check` is a separate subcommand this
        # step never runs, and neither does .pre-commit-config.yaml. A file
        # can pass this step and still drift from `ruff format` (#8795 found
        # tests/conftest.py this way). Not added here: `ruff format --check`
        # currently flags ~2050 files repo-wide, so adopting it needs its own
        # reformat pass, not a silent gate flip on this line.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install "$(grep -E '^ruff==' requirements-lock.txt)"
          python -m ruff check scripts/ tests/ agents_extensions/ dashboards/
      - name: Plan Validate (v2 plans)
        id: plan_validate
        # No tier condition: this check always runs. The validator is
        # path-scoped like content-ci.yml's section7-xref (git diff inside the
        # step): on pull_request it skips unless its inputs changed; other
        # events (merge_group, schedule, dispatch) always run it. The arc
        # landing check after it always runs.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install PyYAML jsonschema
          git fetch --no-tags --prune origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
          validate_plans=true
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            changed=$(git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- \
              curriculum/l2-uk-en/lesson-plans \
              curriculum/l2-uk-en/evidence \
              schemas/module-plan-v2.schema.json \
              scripts/curriculum/validate)
            if [ -z "$changed" ]; then
              echo "No v2 plan inputs changed; skipping the v2 plan validator."
              validate_plans=false
            fi
          fi
          if [ "$validate_plans" = true ]; then
            for level_dir in curriculum/l2-uk-en/lesson-plans/*/; do
              level=$(basename "$level_dir")
              if find "$level_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.yaml' ! -name '_*' | grep -q .; then
                python -m scripts.curriculum.validate "$level" --all --strict
              else
                echo "level $level: no plans"
              fi
            done
          fi
          # Generated arc landing (a1 --check). The landing, module pages and
          # site/src/data/arc-a1.json are generated from _arc.yaml, the plans,
          # the scope sidecars and the build state (#8397); a stale file fails
          # here. It runs on every event: it is cheap and its inputs (state
          # files, site/src/content/docs) are not all under one path.
          python -m scripts.build.build_arc_landing a1 --check
      - name: TypeSafe triage (advisory; docs/best-practices/typesafe-jev.md)
        id: typesafe
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        # Advisory only (#8232): a red triage never fails this job or CI Gate.
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
        run: python3 -m scripts.ci.typesafe_pr_triage

  pytest:
    name: pytest (${{ matrix.shard }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.backend != 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.shards) }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: lu
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    env:
      LEARN_UKRAINIAN_CP_PG_DSN: REDACTED
      LU_PYTEST_TMP_BUDGET_GB: "5"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Historical parity tests read committed source from old SHAs.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version-file: '.python-version'
      - name: Set up uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
        with:
          version: '0.12.9'
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: requirements-lock.txt
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - name: Install native mechanism test dependencies
        run: |
          sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*chrome* /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*google* /var/lib/apt/lists/*chrome* /var/lib/apt/lists/*google*
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y bubblewrap postgresql-16 libpq-dev apparmor
          # Ubuntu-hosted runners require an application-specific userns grant.
          # This profile belongs only to the disposable CI VM.
          if [ -f /proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns ]; then
            cat > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v4-ci-bwrap.apparmor" <<'PROFILE'
          abi <abi/4.0>,
          include <tunables/global>
          profile v4_ci_bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap flags=(unconfined) {
            userns,
          }
          PROFILE
            sudo apparmor_parser -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/v4-ci-bwrap.apparmor"
          fi
          bwrap --unshare-user --unshare-pid --ro-bind / / -- /usr/bin/true
      - name: Install Python deps
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m venv .venv
          # Lockfile is internally inconsistent (marker-pdf vs pillow; see
          # requirements.txt). Documented CI install is `--no-deps`. Drop
          # live-ML wheels — the unit suite does not import them and they
          # blow the 15m budget.
          grep -viE '^(torch|torchvision|open_clip_torch|stanza)==' requirements-lock.txt \
            > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"
          if ! uv pip install --offline --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"; then
            echo 'uv cache incomplete; retrying installation from the index'
            uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"
          fi
          .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation ./packages/v4-runtime
          .venv/bin/python scripts/audit/check_ci_dependencies.py
          .venv/bin/python packages/v4-runtime/build_assets.py
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Hydrate Atlas lexicon manifest
        run: |
          .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from lexicon.manifest_io import load_manifest; load_manifest(); print('Atlas manifest verified against pointer')"
      - name: Download pytest duration source
        if: needs.changes.outputs.pytest_mode == 'full'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: pytest-duration-source
          path: ci-artifacts
      - name: Plan pytest shard files
        if: needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false'
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
          SHARD_COUNT: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.shard_count }}
          PYTEST_MODE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.pytest_mode }}
          PYTEST_CANDIDATES: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.pytest_candidates }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          allowlist="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-shard-${SHARD}-files.txt"
          if [ "$PYTEST_MODE" = "selected" ]; then
            # Candidates resolved once in Changes; do not re-derive stem maps here.
            # Hardcode shard 1/1 so a mismatched shard_count cannot LPT-drop files.
            .venv/bin/python -c 'import json,os; print("\n".join(sorted(json.loads(os.environ["PYTEST_CANDIDATES"]))))' | \
              .venv/bin/python scripts/ci/pytest_shards.py plan-files \
                --shard-id 1 --shard-count 1 \
                --durations scripts/ci/pytest-file-durations.json \
                --output "$allowlist"
          else
            git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | sort | \
              .venv/bin/python scripts/ci/pytest_shards.py plan-files \
                --shard-id "$SHARD" --shard-count "$SHARD_COUNT" \
                --durations ci-artifacts/pytest-file-durations.json \
                --output "$allowlist"
          fi
          echo "LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES=${allowlist}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Start memory sampler
        if: needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false'
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p ci-artifacts
          mem_log="ci-artifacts/mem-shard-${SHARD}.log"
          # Sample controller + execnet worker RSS and whole-VM memory every
          # 15s. RSS sums shared pages more than once; `free` also shows the
          # runner capacity. Neither is a before/after-only peak estimate.
          (
            echo "sampling_interval_seconds=15"
            if [ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max ]; then
              echo "cgroup_memory_max_bytes=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max)"
            fi
            while true; do
              date -u +%FT%TZ
              free -m
              { ps -C python -C python3 -o rss=,args= || true; } | awk '
                /-m pytest|import sys;exec[(]eval/ { rss += $1; processes++ }
                END { printf "pytest_rss_mib=%.1f pytest_processes=%d\n", rss / 1024, processes }
              '
              echo "---"
              sleep 15
            done
          ) >> "$mem_log" 2>&1 &
          echo "$!" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/mem-sampler.pid"
      - name: Run pytest
        env:
          DOCS_ONLY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_only }}
          DOCS_READS_CONTENT: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_reads_content }}
          PYTEST_MODE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.pytest_mode }}
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$DOCS_ONLY" = "true" ]; then
            .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -m docs_skills --strict-markers --timeout=120 \
              --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
            # Docs-only PRs get no other pytest leg, but several repo-wide
            # scanners read docs/ (#8707). Run the marked set under the same
            # narrow allowlist the selected tier uses, so collection stays cheap.
            repo_wide_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-repo-wide-files.txt"
            git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.repo_wide' \
              | sort > "$repo_wide_list" || true
            [ -s "$repo_wide_list" ] || { echo "no repo_wide tests found; the repo_wide marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
            LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$repo_wide_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
              -m 'repo_wide and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
              -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
              --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
            # A curriculum/ or wiki/ docs PR runs no reads_content tests
            # otherwise, so an edit that breaks a test reading those live trees
            # merges green and turns main red on the next full-tier run (#8720).
            # Find the marked modules with the same narrow allowlist pattern as
            # the repo_wide leg; an empty list fails the step loudly.
            if [ "$DOCS_READS_CONTENT" = "true" ]; then
              reads_content_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-reads-content-files.txt"
              git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.reads_content' \
                | sort > "$reads_content_list" || true
              [ -s "$reads_content_list" ] || { echo "no reads_content tests found; the reads_content marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
              LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$reads_content_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
                -m 'reads_content and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
                -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
                --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
            fi
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$PYTEST_MODE" = "content" ]; then
            # Content class (#8399): only tests that read curriculum/site/wiki
            # content (reads_content marker; enforced by
            # tests/test_reads_content_marker_invariant.py), plus the shard
            # safety net run explicitly so it cannot marker-drift away.
            # Marker filter and timeout mirror the full PR tier below (D5).
            mkdir -p ci-artifacts
            .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
              -m 'reads_content and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
              -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
              --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v --durations=25 \
              --junitxml="ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-${SHARD}.xml"
            .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_ci_shard_partition.py -m 'not slow' --timeout=120 \
              --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p ci-artifacts
          # Single initial path + tests/conftest.py's pytest_ignore_collect allowlist
          # hook (LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES, exported above) replaces positional file
          # arguments — cheap collection, not a change in which tests run.
          .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
            --timeout-method=thread -m 'not atlas_release and not slow' --strict-markers \
            --override-ini addopts=-v --durations=25 \
            --junitxml="ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-${SHARD}.xml"
          if [ "$PYTEST_MODE" = "selected" ]; then
            # Repo-wide tree-scanning tests (#8707) have no import link to the
            # changed module, so import selection can never pick them. Run them
            # under their own allowlist so collection stays narrow, whatever
            # candidates the Changes job chose.
            repo_wide_list="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pytest-repo-wide-files.txt"
            git ls-files -- tests | grep -E '/test_[^/]+\.py$' | xargs -r grep -lE 'pytest\.mark\.repo_wide' \
              | sort > "$repo_wide_list" || true
            [ -s "$repo_wide_list" ] || { echo "no repo_wide tests found; the repo_wide marker invariant is broken" >&2; exit 1; }
            LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES="$repo_wide_list" .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests \
              -m 'repo_wide and not slow and not atlas_release' --strict-markers \
              -n logical --dist=loadfile --max-worker-restart=0 --timeout=120 \
              --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v \
              --junitxml="ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-${SHARD}-repo-wide.xml"
          fi
      - name: Stop memory sampler
        if: always() && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false'
        run: |
          if [ -f "${RUNNER_TEMP}/mem-sampler.pid" ]; then
            kill "$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/mem-sampler.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
      - name: Upload pytest JUnit report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: pytest-junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: ci-artifacts/pytest-shard-*.xml
          # docs_only runs skip the "Plan pytest shard files"/junitxml path
          # entirely (short-circuited `docs_skills` run above), so no report
          # ever exists there — "ignore" is correct only for that lane. Any
          # other run that fails to produce a report is a real gap, so it
          # must fail loudly instead of silently uploading nothing.
          if-no-files-found: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true' && 'ignore' || 'error' }}
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Upload memory sample log
        if: always() && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: mem-sample-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: ci-artifacts/mem-shard-*.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  needs-artifact-audit:
    name: Needs artifact audit
    needs: [changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.backend == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version-file: '.python-version'
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@c18668ad3cf93ea998bef934396af7bb5c839dc7 # v10.2.0
        with:
          version: '0.12.9'
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: requirements-lock.txt
      - name: Install Python deps
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m venv .venv
          grep -viE '^(torch|torchvision|open_clip_torch|stanza)==' requirements-lock.txt \
            > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"
          if ! uv pip install --offline --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"; then
            echo 'uv cache incomplete; retrying installation from the index'
            uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/requirements-ci.txt"
          fi
          .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation ./packages/v4-runtime
          .venv/bin/python scripts/audit/check_ci_dependencies.py
          .venv/bin/python packages/v4-runtime/build_assets.py
      - name: Hydrate Atlas lexicon manifest
        run: |
          .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from lexicon.manifest_io import load_manifest; load_manifest(); print('Atlas manifest verified against pointer')"
      - name: Verify needs_artifact skip set
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p ci-artifacts
          git ls-files | grep -E '(^|/)test_[^/]+\.py$' > ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-files.txt
          export LU_PYTEST_SHARD_FILES=ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-files.txt
          .venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -m needs_artifact -q --strict-markers \
            --override-ini addopts= > ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-collected.txt || collection_status=$?
          if [ "${collection_status:-0}" -ne 0 ] && [ "$collection_status" -ne 5 ]; then
            exit "$collection_status"
          fi
          set +e
          .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m needs_artifact --strict-markers --timeout=120 \
            --timeout-method=thread --override-ini addopts=-v \
            --junitxml=ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-audit.xml
          audit_status=$?
          set -e
          # Pytest exits 5 when P0 has no marked tests; the exact-set check
          # below still requires the committed expected set to be empty.
          if [ "$audit_status" -ne 0 ] && [ "$audit_status" -ne 5 ]; then
            exit "$audit_status"
          fi
          .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
          import sys
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          from pathlib import Path
          from scripts.storage.test_baseline import nodeid_to_junit_id

          expected_path = Path("registry/artifacts/needs-artifact-expected.txt")
          expected = {
              line.strip()
              for line in expected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
              if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
          }
          collected = set()
          for line in Path("ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-collected.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
              if ".py::" not in line:
                  continue
              collected.add(nodeid_to_junit_id(line))
          if collected != expected:
              print(f"needs_artifact collection differs: missing={sorted(expected - collected)} unexpected={sorted(collected - expected)}")
              sys.exit(1)
          report = ET.parse("ci-artifacts/needs-artifact-audit.xml")
          artifact_skips = set()
          for case in report.iter("testcase"):
              case_id = f"{case.get('classname', '')}::{case.get('name', '')}"
              skipped = case.find("skipped")
              reason = "" if skipped is None else skipped.get("message", "") + (skipped.text or "")
              if "needs_artifact:" in reason:
                  artifact_skips.add(case_id)
          missing = sorted(expected - artifact_skips)
          unexpected = sorted(artifact_skips - expected)
          if missing or unexpected:

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version-file: '.python-version'
          cache: pip
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - name: Install contract-check dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install PyYAML jsonschema requests==2.34.2 regex==2026.5.9
          npm ci
      - run: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from lexicon.manifest_io import load_manifest; load_manifest()"
      - name: Run Word Atlas sense-lint ratchet (#6437)
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m scripts.practice_deck.io
          base_ref="${BASE_SHA:-origin/main}"
          deck_args=()
          for deck in site/public/lexicon/*.json; do
            deck_args+=(--practice-deck "$deck")
          done
          python scripts/audit/lint_word_atlas.py \
            --manifest site/src/data/lexicon-manifest.json \
            "${deck_args[@]}" --base-ref "$base_ref" \
            --baseline scripts/audit/word_atlas_lint_baseline.json --ratchet --update-baseline
          git diff --exit-code -- scripts/audit/word_atlas_lint_baseline.json
      - run: python scripts/build/generate_lesson_schema.py && git diff --exit-code docs/lesson-schema.yaml
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_mdx_source_parity.py --changed-vs-base origin/main
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_mdx_forward_parity.py --changed-vs-base origin/main
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_teacher_cloze_content.py
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_locked_module_not_published.py --changed-vs-base origin/main
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_mdx_generation_drift.py --changed-vs-base origin/main
      - run: python scripts/lexicon/check_manifest_freshness.py
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_atlas_manifest_enrichment.py
      - name: Gate Atlas POC richness and learner anchors (#3930, advisory since #4515)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          python scripts/audit/audit_atlas_poc_richness.py \
            --max-search-no-visible-gloss 0 \
            --max-old-gate-no-english-anchor 0 \
            --max-poc-thin-pages 900
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_static_practice_assets.py
      - name: Check Atlas vocabulary manifest coverage (advisory, diff-scoped)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |

          python scripts/lexicon/check_manifest_vocabulary_coverage.py --changed-only --base origin/main
      - run: python scripts/audit/check_dossier_wordcount.py --changed
      - name: Validate BIO preparation capsules and active holds
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.event.before }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import os
          import subprocess

          from scripts.orchestration import curriculum_readiness as readiness
          from scripts.orchestration.preparation_evidence import load_manual_evidence

          root = Path.cwd()
          base_sha = os.environ.get("BASE_SHA", "")
          head_sha = os.environ.get("HEAD_SHA", "HEAD") or "HEAD"
          if not base_sha or set(base_sha) == {"0"}:
              base_sha = subprocess.check_output(
                  ["git", "merge-base", "origin/main", head_sha],
                  text=True,
              ).strip()
          changed = set(
              subprocess.check_output(
                  [
                      "git",
                      "diff",
                      "--no-renames",
                      "--name-only",
                      "--diff-filter=AM",
                      base_sha,
                      head_sha,
                  ],
                  text=True,
              ).splitlines()
          )
          deleted = set(
              subprocess.check_output(
                  [
                      "git",
                      "diff",
                      "--no-renames",
                      "--name-only",
                      "--diff-filter=D",
                      base_sha,
                      head_sha,
                  ],
                  text=True,
              ).splitlines()
          )

          _, manifest_slugs = readiness.load_manifest_track(root, "bio")
          manifest_set = set(manifest_slugs)

          def is_bio_preparation_path(raw_path: str) -> bool:
              path = Path(raw_path)
              parts = path.parts
              wiki_slug = (
                  path.name.removesuffix(".sources.yaml")
                  if raw_path.endswith(".sources.yaml")
                  else path.stem
              )
              return (
                  parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "plans", "bio")
                  or parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "bio", "discovery")
                  or raw_path == "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml"
                  or parts[:3] == ("docs", "research", "bio")
                  or (parts[:2] == ("wiki", "figures") and wiki_slug in manifest_set)
              )

          deleted_preparation = sorted(path for path in deleted if is_bio_preparation_path(path))
          if deleted_preparation:
              raise SystemExit(f"BIO preparation files may not be deleted: {deleted_preparation}")

          registry_path = root / "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml"
          evidence = load_manual_evidence(registry_path, manifest_set)
          active_holds = {
              slug
              for slug, gates in evidence.items()
              if gates.get("hold", {}).get("active") is True
          }

          changed_slugs = set()
          for raw_path in changed:
              path = Path(raw_path)
              parts = path.parts
              slug = None
              if parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "plans", "bio"):
                  slug = path.stem
              elif parts[:4] == ("curriculum", "l2-uk-en", "bio", "discovery"):
                  slug = path.stem
              elif parts[:3] == ("docs", "research", "bio"):
                  slug = path.stem
                  try:
                      base_text = subprocess.check_output(
                          ["git", "show", f"{base_sha}:{raw_path}"],
                          text=True,
                          stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                      )
                  except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                      base_text = ""
                  try:
                      head_text = (root / raw_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                  except OSError:
                      head_text = ""
                  if readiness.is_host_path_only_text_change(base_text, head_text):
                      continue
              elif parts[:2] == ("wiki", "figures"):
                  slug = path.name.removesuffix(".sources.yaml") if raw_path.endswith(".sources.yaml") else path.stem
              if slug in manifest_set:
                  changed_slugs.add(slug)

          if "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml" in changed:
              from scripts.orchestration.preparation_evidence import UniqueKeyLoader
              import yaml

              registry_rel = "curriculum/l2-uk-en/bio/promotion-evidence.yaml"
              try:
                  base_registry_text = subprocess.check_output(
                      ["git", "show", f"{base_sha}:{registry_rel}"],
                      text=True,
                      stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                  )
              except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
                  base_registry_text = "version: 1\nentries: {}\n"
              base_registry = yaml.load(base_registry_text, Loader=UniqueKeyLoader)
              head_registry = yaml.load(registry_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), Loader=UniqueKeyLoader)
              base_entries = base_registry.get("entries", {})
              head_entries = head_registry.get("entries", {})
              registry_changed_slugs = {
                  slug
                  for slug in set(base_entries) | set(head_entries)
                  if base_entries.get(slug) != head_entries.get(slug)
              }
              off_manifest_changes = registry_changed_slugs - manifest_set
              if off_manifest_changes:
                  raise SystemExit(
                      f"promotion evidence changed off-manifest slugs: {sorted(off_manifest_changes)}"
                  )
              changed_slugs.update(registry_changed_slugs)

          targets = active_holds | changed_slugs
          for slug in sorted(targets, key=manifest_slugs.index):
              result = readiness.evaluate_preparation("bio", slug, repo_root=root)
              finding_ids = {finding["id"] for finding in result["findings"]}
              if slug in active_holds:
                  if result["next_action"] != "stop" or "PREPARATION_HOLD_ACTIVE" not in finding_ids:
                      raise SystemExit(f"active hold does not fail closed for {slug}")
                  continue
              failed = [item["id"] for item in result["requirements"] if not item["passed"]]
              if failed:
                  raise SystemExit(f"changed BIO capsule is not preparation-ready: {slug}: {failed}")

          print(
              f"BIO preparation PASS: entries={len(evidence)} "
              f"changed_slugs={len(changed_slugs)} active_holds={len(active_holds)}"
          )
          PY

      - working-directory: site
        run: npm ci
      - working-directory: site
        run: npm run build
      - name: Fail on generated practice-artifact drift (#7673 CF)
        # `npm run build` above already ran hydrate, which regenerates these
        # two derived files from their sources. If the freshly-generated
        # content differs from what's committed, hydrate silently rewrote a
        # stale artifact in place — generated-practice-artifacts.test.ts can't
        # catch that on its own because test:unit also runs hydrate first, so
        # by the time it reads "committed", hydrate has already made it match.
        # This step reads the tree before test:unit's hydrate re-runs.
        run: git diff --exit-code -- site/src/data/lexicon-teacher-lesson-keys.json site/src/data/practice-zno-meta.json
      - working-directory: site

  ci-gate:
    name: CI Gate
    # always(), not `always() && !cancelled()` (#8505). A concurrency cancel
    # that lands before this job starts would otherwise skip it, and GitHub
    # treats a skipped required check as success. The step below fails the
    # job when a required dependency was cancelled or skipped unexpectedly.
    if: always()
    needs: [changes, secret-scan, fast-checks, pytest, needs-artifact-audit, contracts, frontend]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Require event jobs
        env:
          DOCS_ONLY: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.docs_only }}
          FRONTEND: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.frontend }}
          BACKEND: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.backend }}
          PREFLIGHT_SCHEDULED: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.preflight }}
          CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          SECRET: ${{ needs.secret-scan.result }}
          FAST_CHECKS: ${{ needs.fast-checks.result }}
          # Step outcomes, not conclusions (see the fast-checks job).
          FC_PREFLIGHT: ${{ needs.fast-checks.outputs.preflight }}
          FC_RUFF: ${{ needs.fast-checks.outputs.ruff }}
          FC_PLAN_VALIDATE: ${{ needs.fast-checks.outputs.plan_validate }}
          FC_TYPESAFE: ${{ needs.fast-checks.outputs.typesafe }}
          PYTEST: ${{ needs.pytest.result }}
          AUDIT: ${{ needs['needs-artifact-audit'].result }}
          SHARD_COUNT: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.shard_count }}
          SHARDS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.shards }}
          CONTRACTS: ${{ needs.contracts.result }}
          FRONTEND_JOB: ${{ needs.frontend.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ok() { [ "$1" = success ]; }
          # `cancelled` is never an allowed skip. A job that the tier did not
          # need may be `skipped`; a cancel before it starts must still fail
          # this gate (skipped required checks count as success on GitHub).
          skip_ok() {
            if [ "$1" = cancelled ]; then
              echo "::error::required job was cancelled"
              exit 1
            fi
            [ "$1" = success ] || [ "$1" = skipped ]
          }
          ok "$CHANGES"
          ok "$SECRET"
          # fast-checks (#8750 phase A.2) runs every check as a step, so its
          # job result alone cannot say which check applied. A cancelled or
          # skipped job fails closed; so does any missing step outcome.
          case "$FAST_CHECKS" in
            success | failure) ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::fast-checks concluded '$FAST_CHECKS'"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          # The tier flags each check condition reads; anything but true/false
          # fails closed instead of choosing a branch.
          for flag in "preflight=$PREFLIGHT_SCHEDULED" "docs_only=$DOCS_ONLY"; do
            case "${flag#*=}" in
              true | false) ;;
              *)
                echo "::error::Changes output ${flag%%=*} is '${flag#*=}', expected true or false"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          done
          fast_checks_ok=true
          # expect CHECK OUTCOME WANT: a check whose condition applied must be
          # `success`; one whose condition did not apply must be `skipped`.
          expect() {
            if [ -z "$2" ]; then
              echo "::error::fast-checks output '$1' is missing"
              fast_checks_ok=false
            elif [ "$2" != "$3" ]; then
              echo "::error::fast-checks step $1 concluded '$2', expected '$3'"
              fast_checks_ok=false
            else
              echo "fast-checks $1: $2"
            fi
          }
          # Preflight (#8750): Changes decides once whether it runs. Scheduled,
          # it must succeed; not scheduled, it must be skipped. merge_group,
          # schedule and workflow_dispatch always take the second branch.
          if [ "$PREFLIGHT_SCHEDULED" = true ]; then want=success; else want=skipped; fi
          expect preflight "$FC_PREFLIGHT" "$want"
          if [ "$DOCS_ONLY" = false ]; then want=success; else want=skipped; fi
          expect ruff "$FC_RUFF" "$want"
          # plan-validate self-scopes to the v2 plan inputs inside the step and
          # has no tier condition, so a skip is never legitimate here.

expect plan_validate "$FC_PLAN_VALIDATE" success
          # Advisory-only (#8232): TypeSafe/Jev is not CF and not merge
          # authority. Any outcome is logged and accepted, so a red TypeSafe
          # step never turns CI Gate red by itself; only a missing output does.
          if [ -z "$FC_TYPESAFE" ]; then

          [ "$fast_checks_ok" = true ] || exit 1
          # Every check passed its rule, yet the job failed: a setup step
          # (checkout, Python, preflight deps) broke. Fail closed.
          if [ "$FAST_CHECKS" = failure ]; then
            echo "::error::fast-checks failed outside its checks; see the job log"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$BACKEND" = false ]; then
            skip_ok "$PYTEST"
            skip_ok "$AUDIT"
          else
            # `needs.pytest.result` (checked by `ok` below) is GitHub's own
            # aggregate over every matrix job instance it created from
            # `fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.shards)`: success only if every
            # instance concluded success, computed at needs-resolution time —
            # not a re-query subject to eventual consistency. The old check
            # re-listed jobs through the run-attempt jobs API right after
            # `needs` resolved and sometimes saw an incomplete page (#8967:
            # 10/10 shards green, Gate read back 6). Cross-check shard_count
            # against the shards array Changes emitted alongside it (both
            # written by one classify_changes call) so a future drift between
            # the two still fails closed, with no API call in the loop.
            ok "$PYTEST"
            if [ "$DOCS_ONLY" = false ]; then ok "$AUDIT"; else skip_ok "$AUDIT"; fi
            case "$SHARD_COUNT" in
              ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "::error::invalid shard count '$SHARD_COUNT'"; exit 1 ;;

            [ "$SHARD_COUNT" -gt 0 ] || { echo "::error::zero pytest shards"; exit 1; }

              echo "::error::Changes.shards is not valid JSON: $SHARDS"
              exit 1
            }

              echo "::error::Changes.shards has $shards_len entries but shard_count=$SHARD_COUNT"

              exit 1

TypeSafe does `git diff base head` (two-dot, no merge-base). This requires both commits to be present, but not full history necessarily — base and head SHAs on GitHub Actions are fetched? With fetch-depth: 0, all refs. With a shallow depth-1 checkout on pull_request, only head commit fetched. Base SHA may not be present. So history/refs needed.

Now let's check if pytest really needs fetch-depth 0. Search tests referencing old SHAs / git history. My first grep didn't show tests (mostly scripts). Let me grep tests specifically for `git` subprocess and `HEAD~`, `origin/main`, `rev-parse`, `show`.
